questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne daga cikin wadannan haruffa ne baya cikin haruffan Hausa na boko?
questions.explanation: Standard Hausa boko orthography excludes the Latin letters Q, X, and V; it uses K, Ƙ, and R among its consonants.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene daidai matsayin harafin 'Ɓ' idan aka kwatanta da 'B' a rubutun Hausa?
options: Ɓ ba a amfani da shi a Hausa
Ɓ baƙi ne mai shaƙuwa (implosive) daban da B
Ɓ da B daya ne kawai a rubuce ba tare da bambanci ba
questions.explanation: Ɓ represents a distinct implosive consonant sound in Hausa, phonemically different from the plain plosive B.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ka'idar rubutun Hausa, yaushe ake amfani da babban harafi (capital letter)?
options: Ba a taba amfani da babban harafi a Hausa
A farkon jimla da kuma sunayen musamman
questions.explanation: As in standard orthographic convention, Hausa capitalises the first word of a sentence and proper nouns such as personal names and place names.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne misali ne daidai wajen amfani da alamar sirara (apostrophe) a Hausa?
questions.explanation: The apostrophe correctly precedes 'yan' in 'yan mata' (girls), marking the elided initial sound, as commonly standardised in Hausa orthography.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene kuskure a wannan jimlar: 'ya tafi kasuwa jiya'?
options: Rashin amfani da babban harafi a farkon jimla
questions.explanation: The sentence should begin with a capital letter: 'Ya tafi kasuwa jiya', since it starts a new sentence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutun Hausa, menene aikin 'waƙafi' (comma)?
options: Yana nuna karshen jimla gaba daya
Yana nuna gajeren tsayawa a cikin jimla domin raba sassa
questions.explanation: The comma (waƙafi) marks a brief pause, typically separating items in a list or clauses within a sentence, without ending the sentence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne daga cikin jimlolin nan biyu ne daidai a fannin rabon kalmomi: 'ba komai' ko 'bakomai'?
questions.explanation: 'Ba komai' (nothing/it's alright) is correctly written as two separate words in standard Hausa orthography, not merged.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira alamar da ake amfani da ita don nuna cewa magana ce ta wani mutum a rubuce, kalma-kalma?
questions.explanation: Quotation marks are used to enclose direct speech or a quoted statement exactly as spoken or written by someone else.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutaccen Hausa, wace hanya ce daidai ta nuna adadi 'talatin da biyar' a matsayin lamba?
questions.explanation: 'Talatin da biyar' translates directly to thirty-five, written numerically as 35.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Me ya sa ake bukatar sanin ka'idojin rubutu sosai kafin rubuta rahoto ko wasika a Hausa?
options: Domin gujewa kuskuren da zai iya canza ma'ana ko rikita mai karatu
Domin karin lokacin da za a dauka wajen rubutu
questions.explanation: Careful adherence to orthographic rules prevents ambiguity or unintended changes in meaning, ensuring the writing is clearly understood.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace kalma ce aka rubuta daidai bisa ka'idar rubutun Hausa?
questions.explanation: 'Malami' (teacher) is the standard, correctly spelt form in Hausa orthography.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutun Hausa, menene bambanci tsakanin 'ƙirƙira' da 'kirkira'?
options: Ƙirƙira daidai ne saboda amfani da hooked ƙ, kirkira kuskure ne
Kirkira daidai ne, ƙirƙira kuskure ne
questions.explanation: 'Ƙirƙira' (to invent/create) requires the hooked Ƙ, which is phonemically distinct from plain K; spelling it with plain 'k' is an orthographic error.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tambayoyin auna fahimta, idan aka nemi 'babban ra'ayi' na labari, mai karatu zai fara da
options: Kirga yawan jimlolin da ke cikin labarin
Neman babban sako da marubuci yake son isarwa
Duba tsawon lokacin da aka dauka wajen rubuta labarin
questions.explanation: Identifying the main idea means locating the central message the writer intends to communicate, not incidental production details.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan wata tambaya ta ce 'menene take/take na dacewa da labarin?', menene ake bukata daga dalibi?
options: Ya zabi kalma ta farko a cikin labarin
Ya zabi kalma ta karshe a cikin labarin
Ya zabi taken da ya fi dacewa da abin da labarin ya kunsa gaba daya
questions.explanation: A suitable title question requires selecting the option that best captures the overall content and theme of the passage, not superficial features.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A wani labari, an ce 'Audu ya yi murna matuka domin ya samu tallafin karatu.' Menene dalilin murnar Audu?
questions.explanation: The sentence directly states Audu's joy was because he obtained a scholarship, a straightforward direct-extraction comprehension question.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Yaya za a iya bambance tsakanin 'gaskiya' (fact) da 'ra'ayi' (opinion) a cikin wani rubutu?
options: Gaskiya za a iya tabbatar da ita, ra'ayi kuwa fahimtar mutum ne game da wani abu
Gaskiya ba za a iya tabbatar da ita ba
questions.explanation: A fact can be verified as objectively true, while an opinion reflects a personal judgement or belief that may vary between individuals.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan tambaya ta bukaci dalibi ya yi hasashen abin da zai faru gaba a labari, wace fasaha ake amfani da ita?
questions.explanation: Predicting or inferring future events in a passage requires reasoning beyond what is explicitly stated, using contextual clues already given.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin jumlar 'Ko da yake ruwa yana sauka, Bala ya ci gaba da tafiya kasuwa', menene ma'anar 'ko da yake'?
options: Duk da cewa (despite the fact that)
questions.explanation: 'Ko da yake' functions as a concessive connective meaning 'even though/despite the fact that', signalling contrast between two clauses.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Idan a cikin labari aka ce 'ta yi fatali da shawarar mahaifiyarta', menene ma'anar 'yi fatali da'?
options: Ki ko yi watsi da wani abu
questions.explanation: The idiomatic expression 'yi fatali da' means to reject or disregard something, here referring to dismissing the mother's advice.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace dabara ce ta fi taimakawa wajen gano amsar tambaya cikin sauri a jarabawar fahimta?
options: Karanta amsoshin kadai ba tare da karanta tambayar ba
Zabi amsa ta farko koyaushe ba tare da tunani ba
Duba kalmomin da ke cikin tambayar sannan a nemo su a sakin layin da suka dace
questions.explanation: An efficient comprehension strategy is scanning for key words from the question within the relevant paragraph to quickly locate supporting evidence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake nufi idan aka ce wani rubutu 'na ba da labari' (narrative) ne?
options: Rubutun da ke koyar da yadda ake yin wani abu kawai
Rubutun da ba shi da wani tsari
Rubutun da ke ba da labarin abubuwan da suka faru, na gaskiya ko na kagaggu
Rubutun da ke bayyana ra'ayin marubuci kawai
questions.explanation: A narrative text tells a story of events, whether real or fictional, typically with characters, setting, and a sequence of happenings.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A cikin labarin da ke cewa 'Talakawa da yawa suna fama da matsalar rashin ruwa mai tsafta', menene babban abin damuwa?
options: Rashin ababen more rayuwa gaba daya
Rashin ruwa mai tsafta ga talakawa
questions.explanation: The sentence explicitly identifies lack of access to clean water among the poor as the central concern being discussed.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wadanne sautuka ne 'a, e, i, o, u' a Hausa?
questions.explanation: The five basic vowel qualities a, e, i, o, u form the vowel inventory of Hausa, produced without significant airflow obstruction.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira baƙaƙen da ake furta su ta hanyar hade wurin fitar iska da baki, kamar 'ts' a Hausa?
questions.explanation: Affricate consonants like 'ts' involve a stop closure immediately released into a fricative, a recognised consonant class in Hausa phonology.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, dogon wasali (long vowel) kamar wanda ke cikin 'baabaa' yana da mahimmancin
options: Kawai kyautata sauti ba tare da canza ma'ana ba
Iya canza ma'anar kalma daga gajeren wasali
questions.explanation: Vowel length is phonemically contrastive in Hausa — long versus short vowels can distinguish word meaning entirely, not just add stylistic effect.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Karin sauti mai sauka (low tone) idan aka canza shi zuwa sama a wata kalma, menene zai iya faruwa?
options: Kalmar za ta zama wasali kadai
Kalmar za ta bata sauti gaba daya
Ma'anar kalmar na iya canzawa gaba daya
questions.explanation: Since Hausa is a tonal language, changing the tone pattern on an otherwise identical word can completely change its meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira aikin da ake yi na hada baƙi biyu domin su zama sauti daya kacal a furuci, misali 'nb' ya zama 'mb'?
questions.explanation: This is a classic example of assimilation, where a nasal consonant changes its place of articulation to match a following consonant.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, wace irin sila ce 'kar' a cikin 'karfe'?
questions.explanation: The syllable 'kar' ends in the consonant 'r', making it a closed syllable by definition.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sautin da ake furtawa ta hanyar toshe iska sannan a saki shi kwatsam, kamar 'p', 'b', 'k', 'g'?
questions.explanation: Plosive (stop) consonants like p, b, k, g are produced by completely blocking airflow then releasing it abruptly.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ilimin karin sauti, menene ake kira kalmomi biyu da ke da sauti daya amma karin sauti daban, wanda ke haifar da ma'ana daban-daban?
options: Kalmomin da karin sauti ya bambanta ma'anarsu (tone-distinguished minimal pairs)
questions.explanation: These are minimal pairs distinguished purely by tone, illustrating tone's role as a meaning-differentiating feature in Hausa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane fanni ne ya fi mayar da hankali kan yadda ake tsara sautukan magana cikin tsari na kalmomi da jimloli?
questions.explanation: Phonology is precisely the branch concerned with how speech sounds are organised and patterned within a language's words and sentences.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene sunan tsarin da ake amfani da shi domin nazarin inda ake fitar da sauti a bakin magana, kamar hakori, harshe, ko lebe?
questions.explanation: Place of articulation describes the specific location in the vocal tract — such as teeth, tongue, or lips — where a sound's airflow is constricted.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sashin kalma da ke ba da ainihin ma'anar kalmar, kafin a kara wani kari?
questions.explanation: The root of a word carries its core lexical meaning, before any prefixes or suffixes are attached.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, kalmar 'malamai' an samo ta ta hanyar
options: Hada kalmomi biyu daban-daban gaba daya
Kara alamar jam'i ga tushen kalma 'malami'
Rage wani baki daga tushen kalma
Sauya wasali kadai ba tare da wata alama ba
questions.explanation: 'Malamai' is the plural of 'malami' formed by adding a pluralising suffix pattern to the singular root.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira hada kalmomi biyu daban-daban domin samar da sabuwar kalma mai ma'ana, kamar 'gidan sarki'?
questions.explanation: Compounding joins two independent words to form a new word or phrase with combined meaning, as in 'gidan sarki' (the chief's house/palace).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ƙirar kalma, menene ake kira kalmomin da aka aro daga wani harshe, misali 'motoci' daga Turanci 'motor'?
questions.explanation: Loan words are terms borrowed from another language and adapted into Hausa, such as 'mota' (car) from English 'motor'.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace hanya ce ake amfani da ita wajen sauya suna zuwa fi'ili ko akasin haka a Hausa?
options: Kara kari domin canza aji na kalma (derivation)
Sauya kalma zuwa wani harshe daban
questions.explanation: Derivational morphology involves adding affixes that can change a word's grammatical class, e.g. from noun to verb or vice versa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kari da ake sawa a farkon kalma, kamar 'ma-' a cikin 'malami'?
questions.explanation: A prefix is an affix attached to the beginning of a word, as opposed to a suffix which attaches at the end.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Kalmar 'ɗalibai' jam'i ce ta wace kalma?
questions.explanation: 'Ɗalibai' (students) is the plural form of the singular noun 'ɗalibi' (student).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, menene ake kira canza fi'ili domin nuna lokacin da aikin ya faru, kamar lokacin da ya wuce ko na yanzu?
questions.explanation: Tense marking on the verb (or through auxiliary particles in Hausa) indicates when an action occurred — past, present, or future.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne daga cikin wadannan misalai ne na kalmar hadaka (compound word) a Hausa?
questions.explanation: 'Mai-gida' (household head, literally 'owner of house') combines 'mai' (owner/possessor of) and 'gida' (house) into a compound word.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira fannin nazarin yadda ake gina kalmomi daga sassa mafi karanci masu ma'ana?
questions.explanation: Morphology studies how words are built from smaller meaningful units such as roots, prefixes, and suffixes.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A gidajen kalmomi (syntax) na Hausa, menene tsarin asali na jimla mai sauki?
options: Fa'ili + Fi'ili + Abin da aka yi wa aiki (Subject-Verb-Object)
Abin da aka yi wa aiki + Fa'ili + Fi'ili
Babu wani tsari da aka kayyade
Fi'ili + Fa'ili + Abin da aka yi wa aiki
questions.explanation: Hausa basic sentence order typically follows Subject-Verb-Object (SVO), similar in structure to many analytic languages.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A jimlar 'Musa ya karanta littafi', menene rawar 'Musa'?
questions.explanation: 'Musa' is the subject (fa'ili) of the sentence, performing the action of reading.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne kalma ce fi'ili (verb) a cikin jimlar 'Yara suna wasa a filin wasa'?
questions.explanation: 'Wasa' (to play) is the action word (verb) in the sentence, describing what the children are doing.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A gidajen kalmomi, menene ake kira kalmar da ke bayyana wani abu game da suna, kamar 'babba' a 'gida babba'?
questions.explanation: An adjective (sifa) describes or qualifies a noun, such as 'babba' (big) describing 'gida' (house).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace jimla ce daidai a fannin tsarin nahawu?
questions.explanation: Only 'Ali ya sayi mota jiya' (Ali bought a car yesterday) follows correct standard Hausa word order; the others scramble the sentence structure.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmar da ke maye gurbin suna domin gujewa maimaitawa, misali 'shi' a maimakon 'Audu'?
questions.explanation: A pronoun (wakilin suna) substitutes for a noun to avoid repetition, such as using 'shi' (he) instead of repeating a name.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A jimlar 'Ta kawo ruwa saboda kishirwa ta kama ta', menene rawar 'saboda' a jimlar?
options: Yana nuna wurin da aikin ya faru
Yana hada jimlar biyu domin nuna dalili
questions.explanation: 'Saboda' (because) is a conjunction linking two clauses to show cause and effect/reason.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira jimlar da take da fa'ili da fi'ili guda daya kacal, ba tare da wata karamar jimla a cikinta ba?
questions.explanation: A simple sentence contains a single subject and a single verb (one independent clause), without additional clauses.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace kalma ce ake amfani da ita domin nuna wuri a cikin jimlar 'Littafin yana kan tebur'?
options: Kan (a matsayin kalmar nuni ga wuri)
questions.explanation: 'Kan' functions here as a locative/prepositional element indicating position — 'on top of' the table.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A gidajen kalmomi na Hausa, menene ake kira canza tsarin jimla domin ta zama tambaya, misali 'Ya tafi kasuwa' zuwa 'Shin ya tafi kasuwa?'
options: Babu wani sauyi da ya faru
questions.explanation: Adding the interrogative marker 'shin' transforms a declarative sentence into a yes/no question.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ma'anar karin magana 'Kowa ya ga dan uwansa da fara, ba ya cewa jajir'?
options: Kada ka amince da dan uwanka
Kada ka yi wa wani abu izgili domin za a iya samun irinsa a kanka
Kowa yana da hakkin dukiyar dan uwansa
Bai kamata a taimaki dan uwa ba
questions.explanation: This proverb warns against mocking others' misfortunes, since one may later find similar trouble affecting oneself or a relative.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene karin magana 'Hakuri maganin duniya' ke koyarwa?
options: Hakuri shine mafita ga matsalolin rayuwa
questions.explanation: This widely known proverb teaches that patience is the key remedy for life's many challenges and hardships.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Karin maganar 'Ruwan bagiwa ba ya kashe kishi' na koyar da
options: Cewa bagiwa dabba ce mai amfani
Cewa taimako marar gaskiya ba ya warware matsala da gaske
Cewa ruwa mai yawa yana da amfani
questions.explanation: This proverb, likening a mirage's water to false help, teaches that superficial or insincere assistance does not truly solve a problem.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin adabin baka ce 'kirari', wanda ake amfani da shi wajen yabon mutum ko dabba?
options: Kalaman yabo ko siffanta wani abu ta hanyar kirari na musamman
questions.explanation: Kirari (praise epithets) are traditional laudatory or descriptive phrases used to honour and characterise a person, animal, or lineage.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene 'tatsuniya' a adabin baka na Hausa?
options: Labarin kirkirarre wanda ake ba da shi domin nishadi da koyarwa, sau da yawa da dabbobi masu magana
Rahoto na gaskiya game da tarihin kasa
questions.explanation: A tatsuniya is a traditional Hausa folktale, often featuring talking animals, told both for entertainment and moral instruction.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban dalilin ba da tatsuniya ga yara a al'adar Hausa da dare?
options: Domin koyar da su darasi na rayuwa da kuma nishadantar da su
Domin su gaji su yi barci nan take
questions.explanation: Storytelling sessions at night traditionally served the dual purpose of entertaining children while imparting moral and social lessons.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin waka ce 'wakar noma', wadda ake raira wa manoma yayin aiki a gona?
options: Wakar aiki (work song) da ke karfafa gwiwar manoma
questions.explanation: Farming songs (wakar noma) are traditional work songs sung to encourage and energise farmers as they labour in the fields.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gajerun jimloli masu ban dariya ko wayo da ake amfani da su domin gwada hankali, kamar 'Me ke da kai amma ba shi da jiki?'
questions.explanation: Riddles (kacici-kacici) are short witty questions used in Hausa oral tradition to test cleverness, often exchanged as a form of play.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene 'habaici' a cikin adabin baka na Hausa?
options: Yabon da ake yi wa sarki kai tsaye
Zambo ko sukar da ake yi wa wani a fakaice, ba tare da ambaton sunansa kai tsaye ba
questions.explanation: Habaici is an indirect form of criticism or satire, aimed at someone without directly naming them, often understood by context.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Karin maganar 'Zaman lafiya ya fi zaman dowa' na koyar da mutane su
options: Su zauna a daji tare da dabbobi
Su ki zama tare da wasu
Ba wa zaman lafiya muhimmanci fiye da wani abu
questions.explanation: This proverb emphasises that peaceful coexistence is more valuable than wealth or comfort gained at the cost of conflict.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira wakokin da ake rerawa a wuraren shagulgulan aure na gargajiya a al'adar Hausa?
questions.explanation: Wedding songs (wakokin aure) are traditional songs performed during marriage celebrations, expressing joy and blessing for the couple.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A karin magana 'In ba ka gyara gida ba, gida zai gyara ka', menene babban darasi?
options: Gida ba shi da wata alaka da mutum
Kula da abin da yake naka ko ya mallake ka
questions.explanation: This proverb teaches responsibility: if you fail to maintain what is yours, circumstances will eventually force hardship upon you.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira wakokin yabon jarumai da suka nuna gwaninta a fagen daga a tsohuwar al'ada?
questions.explanation: War/heroism songs celebrated the bravery and exploits of warriors, a notable genre within traditional Hausa oral poetry.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Karin maganar 'Hannu daya ba ya daukar jinka' na nufin
options: Mutum daya zai iya yin komai shi kadai
Hadin kai yana da muhimmanci wajen kammala manyan ayyuka
questions.explanation: This proverb ('one hand cannot carry a large calabash') stresses the importance of cooperation and unity in accomplishing big tasks.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene 'take' a cikin adabin baka, wanda ake amfani da shi wajen gabatar da wani mawaƙi ko shahararren mutum?
options: Gajeriyar waka ta yabo da ake danganta wa mutum ko iyali
questions.explanation: A 'take' is a short praise chant or musical phrase specifically associated with an individual, family, or lineage in Hausa oral tradition.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Karin maganar 'Kowane mutum ne magajin gyaɗa' na iya nufin
options: Gyada ba ta da wani amfani
Mutum daya ne kadai zai iya cin gyada
Kowa na iya samun rabo ko dama a wani abu na kowa
questions.explanation: This proverb suggests that opportunities or shared resources are open to everyone, not reserved for a select few.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene manufar amfani da 'karin magana' a cikin zance na yau da kullum a al'adar Hausa?
options: Domin kara wa magana armashi da isar da sako a takaice cikin hikima
questions.explanation: Proverbs enrich everyday speech, conveying wisdom and meaning concisely and adding rhetorical flair to communication.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, wa ake dauka a matsayin mai adana da isar da adabin baka daga tsara zuwa tsara?
options: Marubuta da masu ba da labari na gargajiya, kamar tsofaffi da mawaka
questions.explanation: Oral literature is traditionally preserved and transmitted across generations through storytellers, elders, and musicians/griots.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Karin maganar 'Gara a ce an yi wani abu ba daidai ba, da a ce ba a yi kome ba' na karfafa
options: Cewa kuskure ba shi da illa
Muhimmancin yin kokari maimakon zaman kashe wando
Cewa a bar kokari gaba daya
questions.explanation: This proverb encourages effort and action over idleness, suggesting it is better to try and possibly err than to do nothing at all.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira raira waka da amsa waka a tsakanin jagora da 'yan amshi a wakokin gargajiya na Hausa?
questions.explanation: The call-and-response structure, with a lead singer (jagora) and chorus (amshi), is a defining performance feature of traditional Hausa songs.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubutaccen adabi na Hausa da aka fara rubutawa da rubutun Ajami kafin zuwan boko?
questions.explanation: Before the introduction of the Latin-based 'boko' script, Hausa written literature was recorded using the Arabic-based Ajami script.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tarihin adabin Hausa, wace irin gudunmawa ce marubuta irin su Abubakar Imam suka bayar?
options: Rubuta litattafai da suka kafa harsashin zube na zamani a Hausa
questions.explanation: Abubakar Imam is widely recognised as a foundational figure in modern Hausa prose literature, notably through works like 'Ruwan Bagaja'.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira nau'in adabi wanda aka rubuta shi bisa tsari na baiti da amsa-amo, kamar wakokin marubuta na zamani?
questions.explanation: Poetry (waka) in written Hausa literature is typically composed in structured verses with rhyme and metre, unlike prose.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wasan kwaikwayo (drama) a matsayin nau'in rubutaccen adabi na Hausa yana da mahimmanci wajen
options: Bayar da labarin gaskiya na tarihi kadai
Nuna rayuwar zamantakewa ta hanyar wasa da tattaunawa a kan dandali ko allo
questions.explanation: Drama as a literary genre depicts social life through performed dialogue and action on stage or screen, distinct from prose narration.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutaccen adabin Hausa, menene babban bambanci tsakanin 'zube' da 'waka'?
options: Zube rubutu ne na yau da kullum ba tare da tsayayyen tsarin baiti ba, waka kuwa tana da tsari na baiti da amsa-amo
questions.explanation: Prose (zube) is written in ordinary continuous sentences without a fixed verse structure, whereas poetry (waka) follows structured stanzas and rhyme.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace muhimmiyar rawa ce mujallar 'Gaskiya Ta Fi Kwabo' ta taka a bunkasar adabin Hausa na zamani?
options: Ta ba da dama ga marubuta su buga labarai da rubuce-rubuce na Hausa a rubuce
Ta hana rubuta Hausa gaba daya
Ba ta da wata alaka da adabi
questions.explanation: Gaskiya Ta Fi Kwabo, a pioneering Hausa-language newspaper, provided an important early platform for published Hausa writing and literary development.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ra'ayin gama-gari, menene babban jigon da yawancin litattafan Hausa na farko-farko suka fi mayar da hankali a kai?
options: Ilmantarwa da fadakarwa game da zamantakewar al'umma
questions.explanation: Early Hausa novels commonly centred on social education and moral instruction relevant to the community, reflecting their didactic purpose.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wanne fanni ne ake kira nazarin marubuta da ayyukansu a tarihin adabin Hausa?
questions.explanation: Literary history is the study concerned with tracing writers, their works, and the development of a literary tradition over time.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira nau'in labari mai tsawo, cike da hadaddiyar makirci da yawan haruffa, a rubutaccen adabin Hausa?
questions.explanation: A novel is a long-form narrative work featuring complex plot and multiple characters, distinguished from shorter oral forms like riddles.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Me ya sa nazarin rubutaccen adabin Hausa a matakin Post-UTME/JAMB ke bukatar sanin marubuta a matakin gama-gari maimakon dukkan cikakkun bayanan labarin kowane littafi?
options: Domin littattafai ba su da amfani a jarabawa
Domin babu wani marubuci da aka sani a Hausa
Domin auna ilimin dalibi game da muhimman marubuta da gudummawarsu ba tare da bukatar haddace kowane karamin bayani ba
Domin a guji koyar da adabi gaba daya
questions.explanation: General-level literary knowledge — recognising key authors and their significance — is typically what is assessed, rather than exhaustive plot memorisation.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira babban bikin da ake yi domin murnar kammala azumin Ramadan a al'adar Hausawa musulmi?
questions.explanation: Sallah Karama, corresponding to Eid al-Fitr, marks the end of the Ramadan fast and is celebrated widely among Hausa Muslims.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene ake kira gasar da matasa maza ke shiga domin nuna karfin jiki ta hanyar dukan juna da sanda?
questions.explanation: Sharo is a traditional Fulani/Hausa-associated endurance contest in which young men are struck with canes to demonstrate bravery, often as a rite of passage.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin dabi'a ake sa ran mace ta nuna a gargajiyar Hausa da ake kira 'kunya'?
options: Ladabi, tawali'u, da girmama sauran mutane
questions.explanation: 'Kunya' in Hausa cultural context refers to modesty, humility, and respectful decorum expected in social conduct.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gyaran gargajiya na kayan ado na mata a al'adar Hausa, wanda ya kunshi zanen hannu da lele da lalle?
questions.explanation: Traditional adornments such as henna (lalle) designs are a well-known aspect of Hausa women's cultural beautification practices.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene rawar 'Sarki' a tsarin mulkin gargajiya?
options: Shugaban gargajiya da ke kula da al'amuran al'umma da tsare al'ada
questions.explanation: The Sarki (traditional ruler/emir) serves as a customary leader overseeing communal affairs and preserving cultural traditions.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sana'ar gargajiya ta kera kayan aiki da kayan ado daga karafa a al'adar Hausa?
questions.explanation: Blacksmithing is a longstanding traditional craft among the Hausa, producing tools, farming implements, and metal ornaments.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sana'ar gargajiya ta rina tufafi domin samar da launi, wadda birnin Kano ya shahara da ita?
questions.explanation: Kano is historically famous for its indigo dye pits, a traditional craft of dyeing cloth used to produce distinctive coloured fabrics.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene manufar bikin suna da ake yi wa jariri kwana bakwai bayan haihuwa?
options: Nuna wa jama'a arzikin iyaye kadai
Ba jaririn suna a hukumance tare da yin addu'o'i
questions.explanation: The naming ceremony (suna), typically held seven days after birth, formally names the child and includes prayers and blessings.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sanannen abincin gargajiya na Hausa da aka fi sani da shi, wanda ake yi da hatsi kamar dawa ko gero?
questions.explanation: Tuwo, a thick porridge typically made from grains such as guinea corn or millet, is a staple traditional Hausa dish, often served with soup.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene babban dalilin gudanar da 'kalankuwa', wani biki na gargajiya bayan girbi?
options: Fara sabon shekara ta Musulunci kadai
Nuna godiya bayan an gama girbi tare da nishadantar da al'umma
questions.explanation: Kalankuwa is a traditional post-harvest festival celebrating a successful farming season and giving thanks, while entertaining the community.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene rawar da dattawa (elders) ke takawa a warware rikice-rikice a al'adar Hausa ta gargajiya?
options: Su ne kadai ke da hakkin yin sana'a
Ba su da wata rawa a warware rikici
Suna zama alkalai na gargajiya wajen sasanta sabani cikin hikima
questions.explanation: Elders traditionally play a respected mediating role, using wisdom and social standing to resolve disputes within the community.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gargajiyar Hausawa ta gaisuwa da rungumar juna tsakanin tsofaffi da matasa domin nuna girmamawa?
options: Fadar magana ba tare da gaisuwa ba
questions.explanation: Elaborate, respectful greeting customs — differing by age and status — are a core feature of Hausa social etiquette.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kayan kide-kide na gargajiya na Hausa wanda ake amfani da fata domin samar da sauti, kuma ana amfani da shi wajen yabon sarki?
options: Algaita ba ta amfani da fata
questions.explanation: Traditional drums (such as tambari and ganga), made using stretched skins/hides, are commonly used in royal praise music and ceremonies.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, wace kalma ce ake amfani da ita domin nuna hadin kan iyali fadada wanda ya hada da kakanni, iyaye, da 'ya'ya?
questions.explanation: 'Dangi' or 'iyali' refers to the extended family unit central to Hausa social organisation, including grandparents, parents, and children.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sana'ar gargajiya ta saka tufafi da kayan gida daga zaren auduga a al'adar Hausa?
questions.explanation: Weaving (saka) using cotton thread to produce cloth and household items is a well-established traditional Hausa craft.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sana'ar gargajiya ta kira baƙin ƙarfe don yin kayan aiki a al'adar Hausa?
questions.explanation: Blacksmithing (kira) has traditionally been an important craft in Hausa society, producing farming tools and implements.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausa, menene ake kira sana'ar rini na gargajiya da ake yi domin canza launin tufafi?
questions.explanation: Traditional dyeing (rini), especially of indigo cloth, is a well-known craft associated with Hausa cities like Kano.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira taron gargajiya na jama'a domin tattaunawa kan al'amuran al'umma a ƙarƙashin jagorancin sarki ko hakimi?
questions.explanation: Traditional councils or assemblies (majalisa) convened under a chief or emir served as forums for community deliberation.
